shared_elements: carved upright slab-like surface with figural/symbolic decoration
curved/rounded upper contour of the field
symbolic motifs arranged in vertical registers
paired or bilaterally symmetrical motifs flanking a central axis
justification: Both are upright rounded-topped carved surfaces bearing schematic incised motifs organised around a central vertical axis, including a disc-like circular element and mirrored paired forms flanking it, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A shows a densely populated narrative scene of standing human figures with raised arms beneath a rayed sun, over many horizontal lines of dense script signs, whereas B shows a single anthropomorphic block-form body with sparse abstract curvilinear and ring motifs and no figural scene or script registers at all.
